title: SHAHEED HOGAYE MOULA UJAD GAYA KUFA
body:
Tadap ke kehti thi Zainab ye kya hua Bhayya
Hamare Baba ke Sar ko ye kisne zakhmi kiya
Abhi abhi to gaye the Khuda ke ghar Baba
Ye ek Namaazi pa Masjid me kaisa zulm hua
<<MINI>>
Shaheed hogaye Moula Ujad Gaya Kufa
<<DIVIDER>>
Dar e Ali pa hai Kufe ke bekason ka hujoom
Pachhaadein khaati hai Zainab tadapti hai Kulsoom
Jo guzri hai Dil e Abbas par kise maaloom
Shafeeq Baap ka sar par nahi'n raha saaya
<<MINI>>
Shaheed Hogaye Moula Ujad Gaya Kufa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ameer tha Wo ghareebon ka chaahne Waala
Wo jo yateemon ka aur bekason ka waaris tha
Usi ko Sajde me zakhmi kiya hai waawaila
Saro'n ko peet ke Hasnain karte hain girya
<<MINI>>
Shaheed Hogaye Moula Ujad Gaya Kufa
<<DIVIDER>>
Andheri Shab meWo duniya ka MaalikoMukhtaar
Ghareebon aur yateemon ka moniso Gham khwaar
Uthaaye pusht pa khud Rothiyon ka ek ambaar
Ye dekhta tha na ho shehr me koi bhooka
<<MINI>>
Shaheed Hogaye Moula Ujad Gaya Kufa
<<DIVIDER>>
Fizaaein karti hain maatam azeem ye Gham hai
Bahaaein ashk musalsal Ali ka Maatam hai
Zameen Rothi hai chashme falak bhi purnam hai
Sar e shigaafta thaame tadapte hain Moula
<<MINI>>
Shaheed Hogaye Maula Ujad Gaya Kufa
<<DIVIDER>>
Tadap ke Moula se Ummul Baneen ne ye kaha
Hawaale sabko Hasan ke kiya MereAaqa
Huzoor ne Mere Abbas ko nahi'n poochha
Main apne Laal ko sadge karun ke rad ho bala
<<MINI>>
Shaheed Hogaye Moula Ujad Gaya Kufa
<<DIVIDER>>
Bitha ke pehlu me Abbas ko Ali ne kaha
Khuda se maanga tha Tujhko baraa e Karbobala
Khayaal rakhna Nabi Zaadiyon ke Parde ka
Hawaale karta hu'n Shabbir ke Tujhe Beta
<<MINI>>
Shaheed Hogaye Moula Ujad Gaya Kufa
<<DIVIDER>>
Janaaza uth'ta hai Baitush Sharaf se Hyder ka
Hussain rote hain Abbas ko hai sakta sa
Lahad me Binte Payambar bhi karti hain giriya
Rasheed dena hai Binte Ali ko bhi Pursa
<<MINI>>
Shaheed Hogaye Moula Ujad Gaya Kufa
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
